text: Black empty rectangle at top center (x370-910, y45-95) overlaps and cuts off the NEXT objective text right after Continue; facing prover door in List
pt face 80 / face 11 reported ok:false with 8 turns and yaw unchanged (68.7) at low fps; walkto plaque timed out without moving. Had to hold Right / w manually.

Standing at the Prover questions lectern, the NEXT objective banner (top-left) covers the start of the question title 'Could the Prover ever stamp card 81 PROVED?'; same on the main board where it covers Card 12's heading.
After both questions are answered and the closing cards dismissed, the lectern buttons go dark but the crosshair still turns gold with prompt 'E: answer TRUE'.

After solving, the main board shows the best explainer in the room: a table (12 proves it/true; 47 searches forever/not true; 81 searches forever/TRUE) plus a line like 'To the Prover, cards 47 and 81 look the same. Only from outside...'. That line is the smallest text on the board and unreadable even ~3m away; and the table only appears after the closing cards, while the player is facing the lectern on the opposite wall, so it is easy to never see it.
